message.content: {"question":"A block of mass m₁ = 1 kg is attached to one end of a rope going around a pulley. Another block of mass m₂ = 2 kg at rest on a frictionless horizontal plane is tied to the other end of the rope. The pulley has a mass m₂ = 2 kg, a radius R = 20 cm and a moment of inertia I = 3 kgm².
